snippet.title: Wizherd | Official 1.0 Launch Trailer | Play For FREE on Meta Quest
snippet.description:
🚨 WIZHERD 1.0 IS OFFICIALLY HERE 🚨
🗨️ Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/wizherd
🔗 Download Wizherd for FREE on Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/wizherd/24673981072227472/

________________________________________________________________

🧹 NEW IN WIZHERD:

🧹 Brooms – Fly across the world, reach new dungeons, and fight from the air!
⚙️ Broom Customization – Mix and match broom heads, handles, and trails.
🌥️ Celestial Skies Dungeon - Test your aerial skills in a brand-new unique dungeon built specifically around the brand new broom flying mechanics!
📦 Season 3 – New rings, brooms, and cosmetics to unlock!
⏱️ Dungeon Time Trials - Race against the clock and compare your fastest times on the new leaderboards!
📜 Quest Journal - Read and track your active quests anywhere directly from your inventory.

#wizherd #VR #MetaQuest #Quest3 #quest2 #curlyblue
